Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: Use indirect truth tables to determine whether each set of propositions is consistent. If the set is consistent, choose an option with a consistent valuation. (There may be other consistent valuations.)
(T ⊃ U) ⊃ (W ⊃ U)
T ⊃ ~(U ⊃ X)
(T ⊃ ~X) ⊃ W

Options: 
A. Inconsistent
B. Consistent. Consistent valuation when U, W, and X are true and T is false
C. Consistent. Consistent valuation when W and X are true and T and U are false
D. Consistent. Consistent valuation when T and U are true and W and X are false

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
